gen-mystery-quest-gf-cossette-titre: Open jaws on every curve give Mystery Quest a bookish, nostalgic face, with compact ascenders above its lowercase. And it does its best work big and brief, while Cossette Titre sits below with bowls that welcome the eye.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-genos: Open-jawed and bookish, Mystery Quest looks backward. Genos packs its glyphs so close their edges almost kiss, and that tight, contemporary line gives the old-fashioned headings something modern to lean on.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-krona-one: Mystery Quest opens every curve with a wide jaw and tucks compact ascenders above its lowercase, giving a bookish, nostalgic look. Krona One, loosely spaced and cast-iron sturdy, holds the text underneath.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-mukta: Mystery Quest wears open jaws on every curve, giving headings a bookish, nostalgic face. And Mukta, with its tall-bodied small letters, gives that old-style charm a clean, current counterweight.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-mukta-malar: Wistful, bookish curves with open jaws: that is Mystery Quest, with ascenders kept compact above its lowercase. And Mukta Malar, its ascender length compressed, sits beneath as a modern, approachable counterpart.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-narnoor: Nostalgic and bookish, Mystery Quest opens every curve wide. Its compact ascenders do their best work large and brief, while Narnoor settles in beneath with short ascenders above big bowls.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-play: Play keeps its capitals and lowercase close in height and varies stroke weight only faintly, which suits steady text. Mystery Quest, meanwhile, saves its bookish, open-jawed charm for headings.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-ramabhadra: Open jaws, bookish charm, nostalgic curves: that is Mystery Quest up top, with compact ascenders. Ramabhadra, with its prominent x-height, would keep paragraphs moving smoothly from one line to the next.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-roboto-condensed: Nostalgic from its open-jawed curves, Mystery Quest is a heading face for big, bookish moments. But Roboto Condensed does the opposite job, gliding along like wire with barely visible gaps inside each word.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-spline-sans-mono: Spline Sans Mono lays down fixed-width, code-style letters with a bold, constant stroke and lowercase nearly matching its capitals. And Mystery Quest, bookish and nostalgic, pulls against that precision, old-fashioned curves beside a machine-ruled line.
